The SMILES string with atom mapping and stereochemistry may be invalid for the tool. Need to provide a plain SMILES without atom mapping tags. The target SMILES includes atom mapping [CH2:1]=[C:2]... which is not a standard SMILES. We need to strip mapping and stereochemistry to a valid SMILES. Let's convert to a regular SMILES: The core: CH2=C(Ph)C1CCC(C1O)C(F)(F)F? Actually the cyclopentane: C1CC[C@@](C(F)(F)F)(O)C1? plus attached to the alkene carbon. So approximate SMILES: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C@@](C(F)(F)F)(O)C1. Need stereochemistry maybe not needed. So use "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C](C(F)(F)F)(O)C1". But need correct valence: The alkene carbon attached to phenyl and to cyclopentane carbon. So SMILES: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C](C(F)(F)F)(O)C1. That is "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C](C(F)(F)F)(O)C1". Remove spaces: "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C](C(F)(F)F)(O)C1". That should be valid.

Now search templates with functional_groups_broken "C-C double bonds". Use this SMILES.
